title: Bulk URL status checker input
description: Paste URLs, load a remote list, or point at another Actor's dataset / key-value record (compatible with Sitemap URL Extractor dataset rows and DOC_TO_MARKDOWN_INPUT). Each URL is checked with HEAD, falling back to GET when HEAD is blocked.

urls.title: URLs to check
urls.description: One or more URLs. Accepts `{"url": "..."}` objects (same shape as Sitemap Actor dataset rows and DOC_TO_MARKDOWN_INPUT). You can also paste plain URL strings or use a remote text list (`requestsFromUrl`).

datasetId.title: Source dataset ID
datasetId.description: Optional. Apify dataset ID from another Actor run (e.g. Sitemap URL Extractor). Reads the `url` field from each item. Combined with `urls` if both are set.

keyValueStoreId.title: Source key-value store ID
keyValueStoreId.description: Optional. Apify key-value store ID. Used with Record key below to load a JSON list such as DOC_TO_MARKDOWN_INPUT (`{"urls":[{"url":...}]}`) or a plain URL array.

keyValueRecordKey.title: Record key
keyValueRecordKey.description: Key inside the source key-value store (e.g. `DOC_TO_MARKDOWN_INPUT`). Ignored unless a store ID is set.

maxUrls.title: Max URLs
maxUrls.description: Stop after checking this many unique URLs (0 = no limit). Also caps cost.

outputFilter.title: Dataset filter
outputFilter.description: Which checked URLs to save in the dataset. SUMMARY always includes counts for every URL checked. `all` = every URL; `broken` = not OK (4xx/5xx/network error); `redirects_and_errors` = 3xx + broken; `3xx` / `4xx` / `5xx` = that status class only; `errors_only` = network/DNS/timeout/SSL (no HTTP status).
enumTitles: Network / DNS / timeout / SSL errors only

httpMethod.title: HTTP method
httpMethod.description: `head_then_get` (default): try HEAD, fall back to a streamed GET when the server returns 403/405/501 or an empty response. `head`: HEAD only. `get`: GET only (headers; body is not stored).

followRedirects.title: Follow redirects
followRedirects.description: Follow HTTP redirects and record the final URL. When off, the first response status is kept (often 3xx).

maxConcurrencyPerHost.title: Max concurrency per host
maxConcurrencyPerHost.description: Parallel requests to any single host (kept low to be polite).

minDelayMsPerHost.title: Min delay per host (ms)
minDelayMsPerHost.description: Minimum milliseconds between starting requests to the same host (simple rate limit). 0 = no extra delay.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout for each HTTP request (connect + read).

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: Retries for timeouts, network blips, HTTP 429 and selected 5xx (exponential backoff, honours Retry-After up to 30 s). DNS and certificate failures are not retried.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use a proxy if a site blocks data-center IPs. Not needed for most public sites.
